LESSON: PRACTICES

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.1: PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about PRACTICES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when washing hands our hands?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. tell the importance of (5 Lessons) personal hygiene
2. wash hands appropriately
3. tell critical times to wash hands
4. appreciate the need to wash hands at critical times handwashing poems related to handwashing talk about critical times for hand washing pictures and posters on steps on hand washing 132 importance of washing hands picture puzzles on hand washing steps Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. tell the importance of (5 Lessons) personal hygiene
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to tell the importance of (5 Lessons) personal hygiene. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. wash hands appropriately
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to wash hands appropriately. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. tell critical times to wash hands
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to tell critical times to wash hands. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the need to wash hands at critical times handwashing poems related to handwashing talk about critical times for hand washing pictures and posters on steps on hand washing 132 importance of washing hands picture puzzles on hand washing steps Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the need to wash hands at critical times handwashing poems related to handwashing talk about critical times for hand washing pictures and posters on steps on hand washing 132 importance of washing hands picture puzzles on hand washing steps Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about PRACTICES.
2. Explain PRACTICES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand PRACTICES.
4. Show that you can: tell the importance of (5 Lessons) personal hygiene
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about PRACTICES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when washing hands our hands?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. tell the importance of (5 Lessons) personal hygiene
2. wash hands appropriately
3. tell critical times to wash hands
4. appreciate the need to wash hands at critical times handwashing poems related to handwashing talk about critical times for hand washing pictures and posters on steps on hand washing 132 importance of washing hands picture puzzles on hand washing steps Core-Competences to be developed:
